name: io.github.pvliesdonk/logodev-mcp
title: Logo.dev MCP
description: Look up company logos and brand data via the logo.dev API.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_KV_STORE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Persistent-state backend URL shared by every pvl-core subsystem that needs state. `memory://` is in-process and lost on restart; `file:///path` persists on one server; `redis://`, `dynamodb://` and `mongodb://` each need their matching extra. When unset, defaults to `file:///data/state` (the volume family Docker images mount), or to `memory://` — with a warning — on a host where that directory is not usable.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_TOOLS_ALLOW
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names this instance exposes; every other tool is hidden from listings and cannot be invoked. Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_deny`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_TOOLS_DENY
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names hidden from this instance (absent from listings, cannot be invoked). Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_allow`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_SERVER_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Rename this server instance; defaults to the project name.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS
environmentVariables.description: Replaces the default MCP instructions text sent to clients.

environmentVariables.name: FASTMCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level for FastMCP internals and app loggers (DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR / CRITICAL). The -v CLI flag overrides to DEBUG.

environmentVariables.name: FASTMCP_ENABLE_RICH_LOGGING
environmentVariables.description: Set false for plain or structured JSON log output.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public base URL of the deployed server, e.g. `https://mcp.example.com`. Required for OIDC. Also the fallback source of the MCP Apps domain when `app_domain` is unset.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Single shared bearer token; enables bearer auth unless `bearer_tokens_file` is set, which takes precedence.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_OIDC_CONFIG_URL
environmentVariables.description: OIDC discovery document URL, e.g. `https://auth.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration`.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_OIDC_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OIDC client identifier registered with the provider.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OIDC client secret registered with the provider.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_OIDC_AUDIENCE
environmentVariables.description: Expected `aud` claim; tokens issued for another audience are rejected.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_OIDC_REQUIRED_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Scopes a caller must present, space- or comma-separated. Defaults to `openid` in oidc-proxy mode.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_OIDC_JWT_SIGNING_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Signing key for issued JWTs; used in oidc-proxy mode only. When unset, the key is derived deterministically from `oidc_client_secret`, so tokens survive a restart — but rotating that secret invalidates every issued token. Set this explicitly to decouple token validity from secret rotation. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_OIDC_VERIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Validate the access token instead of the id token.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_KV_STORE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Persistent-state backend URL shared by every pvl-core subsystem that needs state. `memory://` is in-process and lost on restart; `file:///path` persists on one server; `redis://`, `dynamodb://` and `mongodb://` each need their matching extra. When unset, defaults to `file:///data/state` (the volume family Docker images mount), or to `memory://` — with a warning — on a host where that directory is not usable.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_APP_DOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: MCP Apps iframe domain, used for CSP sandboxing. Overrides the host derived from `base_url`.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_TOOLS_ALLOW
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names this instance exposes; every other tool is hidden from listings and cannot be invoked. Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_deny`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_TOOLS_DENY
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names hidden from this instance (absent from listings, cannot be invoked). Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_allow`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Explicit auth-mode override, accepting `remote` or `oidc-proxy` (case- and whitespace-insensitive). When unset the mode is auto-detected from which auth variables are set; the override exists because having all four OIDC variables set is ambiguous between those two modes. Other values are ignored with a warning.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_BEARER_TOKENS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a TOML file mapping bearer tokens to subjects; overrides the single-token `bearer_token` mode.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_BEARER_DEFAULT_SUBJECT
environmentVariables.description: Subject assigned to the single-token bearer mode; ignored when `bearer_tokens_file` is set, since mapped mode carries per-token subjects.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_SERVER_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Rename this server instance; defaults to the project name.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS
environmentVariables.description: Replaces the default MCP instructions text sent to clients.

environmentVariables.name: LOGODEV_MCP_HTTP_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Mount path for the MCP endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PUID
environmentVariables.description: Run the server process as this UID; the container entrypoint chowns writable paths to match.

environmentVariables.name: PGID
environmentVariables.description: Run the server process as this GID; pair with PUID to match the owner of a mounted volume.

environmentVariables.name: FASTMCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level for FastMCP internals and app loggers (DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR / CRITICAL). The -v CLI flag overrides to DEBUG.

environmentVariables.name: FASTMCP_ENABLE_RICH_LOGGING
environmentVariables.description: Set false for plain or structured JSON log output.
